_README: EXAMPLE curriculum (fictional 'Acme ERP' program). Built from training-needs-builder/examples/training_needs.example.json — maps_to_needs references those TN ids.

modules.title: Refunds & Overrides at the POS

learning_objectives.text: By the end, the learner can process a standard refund at the POS without assistance.
By the end, the learner can trigger and complete a manager-override refund correctly.

modality_blend.experiential: In-app guided refund walkthroughs at the terminal during shift (sandbox mode)
modality_blend.social: Shift-lead shadowing on first three live refunds
modality_blend.formal: 5-minute microlearning + one-page job aid at the register

content_outline: Refund types and when override is required

assessment.mastery_threshold: Completes both refund types unassisted in sandbox

modules.title: Working with Automated Replenishment

learning_objectives.text: By the end, the learner can review, adjust, and approve system-generated replenishment suggestions.
By the end, the learner can explain when to override a suggestion and document why.

modality_blend.experiential: Two weeks of live suggestion reviews with override journaling
modality_blend.social: Manager-led coaching huddles comparing overrides vs. outcomes (primary band — mindset-driven need)

non_training_gates: Sponsor message on why suggestions are trusted (comms, not training)
Override-accountability decision confirmed with Ops leadership
content_outline: Why the system suggests what it suggests

assessment.mastery_threshold: Two consecutive weeks with documented, defensible overrides only

maps_to_impacts: Automated replenishment replacing manual reorder spreadsheets

modules.title: Demand Planning Foundations

learning_objectives.text: By the end, the learner can describe each step of the Acme ERP demand-planning cycle and its inputs.
By the end, the learner can navigate the planning module and locate forecast, history, and exception views.

modality_blend.experiential: Sandbox navigation labs with real (anonymized) history data
modality_blend.social: Cohort discussion: how today's manual process maps to the new cycle
modality_blend.formal: ILT session on planning concepts and module structure

content_outline: Data inputs and where they come from
From spreadsheet habits to system discipline
maps_to_impacts: Demand planning introduced as net-new capability

modules.title: Running the Demand-Planning Cycle

learning_objectives.text: By the end, the learner can execute a full demand-planning cycle end to end in the planning module.
By the end, the learner can analyze forecast exceptions and choose the correct resolution.

modality_blend.experiential: Two supervised practice cycles in sandbox, then first live cycle with super-user support
modality_blend.social: Super-user coaching through the first two live cycles
modality_blend.formal: Scenario-based ILT: exception patterns and resolutions

assessment.mastery_threshold: Completes a full sandbox cycle with correct resolution of 4 of 5 seeded exceptions

maps_to_impacts: Demand planning introduced as net-new capability

modules.title: Automated Posting & Daily Reconciliation

learning_objectives.text: By the end, the learner can reconcile daily store sales to the GL using the automated posting reports.
By the end, the learner can analyze posting exceptions and route them to the correct resolution path.

modality_blend.experiential: Reconcile three days of sandbox postings, including seeded exceptions
modality_blend.social: Peer review of exception decisions with a senior analyst

assessment.mastery_threshold: Reconciles one sandbox day unassisted, all exceptions routed correctly

maps_to_impacts: Store sales posting automated to GL; manual journal entries retired

modules.title: Super-User Deep Dive & Train-the-Trainer

learning_objectives.text: By the end, the learner can perform every frontline, lead, planner, and analyst task in their BU's scope.
By the end, the learner can coach a colleague through a task using the ask-show-watch method.
By the end, the learner can evaluate a colleague's exception decision and give corrective feedback.

modality_blend.experiential: Full task circuit across their BU's modules in sandbox
modality_blend.social: Practice coaching sessions with peer feedback

assessment.mastery_threshold: Delivers one observed coaching session rated ready by the facilitator

maps_to_impacts: Demand planning introduced as net-new capability
Automated replenishment replacing manual reorder spreadsheets
Store sales posting automated to GL; manual journal entries retired

assessment_plan.approach: Backward design: objectives written first, assessments designed against them, content outlined last. Every module assessment gates mastery before the learner is counted go-live ready.
assessment_plan.levels: L1 reaction via post-session pulse; L2 learning via the module assessments above; L3 behavior via replen-trust-01 observation and post-go-live usage checks; L4 results via the rollout measurement plan tied to CIA value levers.
assessment_plan.mastery_policy: Frontline must pass the POS task check before floor access at go-live. Planners must pass the scenario assessment before running a live cycle unsupervised.
assessment_plan.ties_to_value: L4 links to the CIA value levers: stockout reduction (replenishment adoption), inventory efficiency (planning cycle quality), close-cycle time (automated posting adoption).
